claims: Olivier Rioux is the tallest college basketball player in history.
Olivier Rioux is a freshman (redshirt) for the Florida Gators (NCAA).
Olivier Rioux was born on February 2, 2006.
Olivier Rioux is from Terrebonne, Quebec, Canada.
Olivier Rioux was previously named the world's tallest teenager.
Rioux broke the previous records for tallest college basketball player to play, score, and appear in an NCAA tournament game, according to The New York Times.
Olivier Rioux was 6-foot-1 at age 8, say Yahoo Sports.
Olivier Rioux surpassed 7 feet before seventh grade, say Yahoo Sports.
Olivier Rioux has a 10-foot standing reach.
At 16, Olivier Rioux was certified as the world's tallest teenager (7-foot-5) by Guinness World Records.
